sam: Hey all — accepted the org invite this morning but when I try to push I get a permissions error. SSO MFA flow also failed with a weird message about multiple accounts. Anyone know who I should ping? cc @maria

maria: welcome! can you paste the exact error and what email you accepted the invite with?

sam: sure — I accepted to sam.work+redwood@gmail.com (that's my work alias). Error when pushing:
```
$ git push origin main
Permission to redwood-inference/platform.git denied to sam-personal.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```
Also when I go through SSO it pops: "SSO blocked: account contains multiple emails; complete verification on GitHub to enable enforcement" and then it loops.

it-support: thanks — two likely issues: 1) you have a personal GitHub account where your local credential helper is caching a token for sam-personal; 2) the org requires SSO and the account that accepted invite doesn't have the org-managed email verified. Can you run `git config user.email` and `gh auth status` and paste outputs?

sam: `git config user.email` -> sam.work+redwood@gmail.com; `gh auth status` shows I'm logged into sam-personal (work email not connected). I didn't realize my personal account used the alias too.

alex: quick runbook we've used before: if you have two GH accounts sharing emails, easiest is to accept invite with the work-managed account. We can either re-send the invite to the other GitHub username or merge/rename accounts, but re-invite is faster. @it-support can you check which GitHub username accepted the invite?

it-support: checked — the org recorded `sam-personal` as the user who accepted. I'll re-send the invite to the GitHub username that matches your work identity. Sam, can you DM me the GitHub handle you want associated (or confirm you want `sam-work`)?

sam: I want it associated with `sam-work` (that's the account I use for org stuff). I don't want to fuss with merging.

it-support: ok re-sending invite to `sam-work` now. Also to unblock immediate pushes, you can remove cached credentials locally: on mac/linux run `git credential-osxkeychain erase` or `printf "host=github.com\nprotocol=https\n" | git credential-cache exit` and then `gh auth login` to re-auth. If you use SSH, check `ssh -T git@github.com` to verify which key maps to which account.

sam: thanks — followed the steps, re-authenticated with `gh auth login` and accepted the new invite. Still seeing the SSO page during the flow but it completed this time.

github-bot: invite re-sent to sam-work for org redwood-inference (reason: accepted under wrong account).

sam: OK pushed a small fix to main and it worked :raised_hands: — `git push` success. Thanks everyone for the quick help.

maria: awesome, welcome aboard! if you want I'll add you to platform and infra teams now.

sam: please add me to platform team. Also leaving notes here for future hires: if you have multiple GH accounts with shared emails, accept invites with the account you plan to use for work and verify the org-managed email in your GH settings (Settings -> Emails -> verify).

alex: adding as a follow-up for onboarding doc: we should include a short checklist for new hires about GH account aliases, `gh auth login`, and SSH key checks. Filing a small ticket.

it-support: closing this thread — resolved. :white_check_mark:
